prev_row.boundary_rationale: A doubled imperative opens this row, הִתְמַהְמְה֣וּ וּתְמָ֔הוּ הִשְׁתַּֽעַשְׁע֖וּ וָשֹׁ֑עוּ (oshb:Isa.29.9, byte tier), “Pause and wonder! Blind yourselves and be blind!” (web:Isa.29.9), a fresh imperative onset (four forms) after the deliverance unit closing at web:Isa.29.8. The blindness announced there is illustrated by the sealed-book simile “All vision has become to you like the words of a book that is sealed” (web:Isa.29.11, a ketiv/qere-bearing verse at Isa.29.11, quoted here up to the point before its varying token). The speech-frame וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲדֹנָ֗י (oshb:Isa.29.13, byte tier), a divine frame, continues the same indictment of lip-service worship rather than opening a fresh unit: the indictment's object continues from the blinded people of Isa.29.9-Isa.29.12 even as the person-marking turns from second-person plural to third-person report, and no fresh frame opens between them. The row closes on “the understanding of their prudent men will be hidden.” (web:Isa.29.14), the verse just before the next hoy onset at web:Isa.29.15.
prev_row.strongest_rejected_alternative: A rival cut would open a fresh unit at the divine speech-frame וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲדֹנָ֗י (oshb:Isa.29.13, byte tier) rather than holding it with the blindness oracle that precedes it; it is rejected because the indictment's object continues from Isa.29.9-Isa.29.12 and no fresh frame separates the two.
prev_row.literature_type_guess: oracle of spiritual blindness built around the sealed-book simile and an indictment of hollow worship
